verdict.rationale: Rootly documents Workflows as its automation engine. Workflows run structured actions automatically from trigger events and run conditions, with 152 action types including AI actions, and handle channel creation, stakeholder updates, ticket filing and retros "the same way every time." AI SRE investigation rules also let users configure which alerts get investigated autonomously, and Meeting Scribe joins incident bridges automatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these background automations run reliably without supervision.
